bp_md.disposition: Retained optional legacy breakpoint input for the specifically listed banner/CTA/form consumers. Not a theme-wide responsive grid control. No saved value in this repository.
bp_md.precedence: Optional legacy value > consumer fallback 768px. Other sections retain their own breakpoints.
bp_md.legacy_value_contract: Numeric CSS pixel breakpoint; fallback 768. Not a new supported merchant UI control.

bp_lg.disposition: Retained optional legacy breakpoint input for the specifically listed banner/CTA/form consumers. Not a theme-wide responsive grid control. No saved value in this repository.
bp_lg.precedence: Optional legacy value > consumer fallback 1024px. Other sections retain their own breakpoints.
bp_lg.legacy_value_contract: Numeric CSS pixel breakpoint; fallback 1024. Not a new supported merchant UI control.

captcha_recaptcha_site_key.disposition: Retained public provider-specific key fallback, now centralized in form-captcha-key. No saved value in this repository. Never a verification secret.
captcha_recaptcha_site_key.precedence: Section key > matching provider legacy key > captcha_site_key when provider matches the selected global provider.
captcha_recaptcha_site_key.legacy_value_contract: Public browser site key text; blank/none means unavailable.

captcha_turnstile_site_key.disposition: Retained public provider-specific key fallback, now centralized in form-captcha-key. No saved value in this repository. Never a verification secret.
captcha_turnstile_site_key.precedence: Section key > matching provider legacy key > captcha_site_key when provider matches the selected global provider.
captcha_turnstile_site_key.legacy_value_contract: Public browser site key text; blank/none means unavailable.

custom_css.disposition: Retained legacy merchant CSS in both document layouts. HTML delimiters are escaped as CSS code points. No saved value in this repository.
custom_css.precedence: Injected after the corresponding shared/scoped styles; ordinary CSS cascade applies. No new Theme Editor field.
custom_css.legacy_value_contract: CSS text; intentional trusted customization, not HTML execution.

fb_page_id.disposition: Retained Facebook Page Plugin URL fallback. Section validates HTTPS Facebook hosts; no Graph API key or live-feed backend is implied.
fb_page_id.precedence: Local Facebook URL > social_url_facebook > derived HTTPS Facebook URL from fb_page_id.
fb_page_id.legacy_value_contract: Public Facebook page path/ID; blank/none absent.

feed_card_radius.disposition: Retained Facebook embed card radius. No schema or saved value in this repository; other card families do not consume it.
feed_card_radius.precedence: Legacy global value > 16px fallback for the Facebook section only.

marketing_double_opt_in.disposition: Retained optional form transport metadata, not an installed integration or a consent action. External receivers must implement any behavior. No saved value in this repository.
marketing_double_opt_in.precedence: Passed to supported form hosts/dispatch as metadata. Native Shopify transport and explicit newsletter confirmation remain authoritative. See integration-contracts.md.
marketing_double_opt_in.legacy_value_contract: Boolean metadata for double-opt-in/field mappings; text metadata for provider, proxy and attribution. Consumer defaults are recorded with each source edge.
